name: Content Writer
title: Content Writer
intro: The content writing roadmap: language skills, niches, portfolio, freelance and full-time job routes.

phases.title: School and graduation: language base
phases.summary: Good writing begins with reading and regular practice.
points: Any degree works; BA English, BJMC, BBA or B.Com are common, and subject knowledge can become your niche.
Read newspapers, books, long-form articles and blogs; note how they are structured.
Write regularly and ask for feedback.
Learn grammar, punctuation and plain-language style.

phases.title: Writing craft and niches
phases.summary: Learn different forms and pick a niche.
points: Practise blog posts, product descriptions, ad copy, social media posts and email newsletters.
Choose a niche such as technology, finance, health, education, travel or lifestyle.
Learn how to research, verify facts and cite sources.
Edit your own work for clarity and brevity.

phases.title: SEO, tools and digital basics
phases.summary: Make content easy to find and measure.
points: Learn search engine optimisation basics: keywords, headings, meta descriptions and internal links.
Use tools such as Google Docs, Grammarly, Canva and a CMS like WordPress.
Learn basic analytics to see which content works.
Understand plagiarism, copyright and ethical use of AI tools.

phases.title: Portfolio and first jobs
phases.summary: Show work samples and start earning.
points: Create a portfolio with 8–10 samples, including a personal blog or published articles.
Start with internships, guest posts or freelance platforms.
Apply for entry roles at agencies, start-ups, publishers and in-house marketing teams.
Learn to pitch, meet deadlines and handle revisions professionally.

phases.title: Growth paths
points: Become a senior content writer, content strategist, SEO specialist or editor.
Move into UX writing, technical writing or scriptwriting.
Freelance or build your own publication or newsletter.
Consider courses in digital marketing or a master’s in media or English.
